{{Quote|Such a fascinating society the Geonosians have made for themselves here. Have you managed to catch any of the ritual combats during your visit?|Maru Jakkar, to her fellow guests during Duke Piddock's party on Geonosis|<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt">{{FFG|story=The Long Arm of the Hutt|book=Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Beginner Game|text=''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Beginner Game}}</ref>}}
'''Maru Jakkar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as the frontwoman for a branch of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jakkar traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] to attend a party held by the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Duke/Legends|Duke]] [[Piddock]]. Jakkar concealed her true affiliation from the other guests at the party by using a cover story that she had an interest in Geonosian culture and was on Geonosis to purchasee antiques to conceal her true affiliation from the other guests, and during the event she held a private meeting with Piddock.<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />

==Personality and trains==
Jakkar was a slender woman and she had a cold, sophisticated persona and she was cordial and polite in her interactions with others. She found [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to be fascinating but also held a strong dislike for [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="The Long Arm of the Hutt" />
